TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest and the USERCODE request header, then ABKOR001Impl.executePutPricingRules() loads the existing rule with PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(id), loads its active details with getDetailsByRuleId(id), copies those details into the existing DTO, forces pricingRule.pricingRuleType from the existing rule, validates active status, allowed statuses, future start date and restricted synchronized updates with PricingRuleValidator.validatePut(existing, pricingRule, hasActiveChildren), and, when details are present, sorts the input details and validates duplicate configurations with PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut(pricingRule). 2. Decisions and branches: if getPricingRuleById(id) returns null, executePutPricingRules() adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns null; if validatePut() or the duplicate validator raises a PricingRuleException, executePutPricingRules() catches it, adds the advice with its description and returns null; otherwise setOptinalValues() copies existing comments, precedenceType and progressiveType when they are absent, PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues() resolves each detail value, and the flow branches by existing.getStatus(): SYC creates a new version in handleSycUpdate(), while other statuses synchronize added and removed details through syncDetails() and then update the current rule. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(); inside ABKOR001Impl.executePutPricingRules(), PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(), getDetailsByRuleId(), hasActiveChildren(), fillDetailValues(), syncDetails(), deactivateDetail(), insertAudit(), insertPricingRule(), insertDetails() and JdbcUtils.update() are used to read the existing rule, resolve detail labels, deactivate or insert detail rows, and persist either a new version or an update, while PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut() invokes PutPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.validate() to compare sorted details and fees against candidate rules. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: executePutPricingRules() adds ABKO10000405 when getPricingRuleById(id) finds no rule; PricingRuleValidator.validatePut() throws ABKO10000407 when actual.getActive() is false, ABKO10000408 when status is not PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE or SYC, ABKO10000417 when status is SYC and hasActiveChildren is true, ABKO10000413 when UtilDates.validateActivationDate(updated.getEffectiveDate()) is false, and ABKO10000414 when a synchronized rule changes forbidden main fields, fee type or non-SET details; PutPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.validatePricingRuleType() throws ABKO10000416 when pricingRuleType is not V, R or P; UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists() throws ABKO10010401 when another candidate matches the functional configuration, and throwPaymentMethodOverlap() throws ABKO10010415 when a variable candidate overlaps by payment method; PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues() throws ABKO10010004 when no lookup query exists, the resolved value is blank or the detail id does not exist; syncDetails()/deactivateDetail() or updatePricingRule() emit ABKO00000010 when the database update result is 0; after execute() sets the output, assignSeverityError() sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: on the success path execute() always calls setPricingruleresponse(pricingRule); executePutPricingRules() returns the same request DTO after filling detail values, setting pricingRuleType from the existing rule, copying missing optional fields, setting status to PAU, setting parentId for non-SYC updates, and keeping id as the input pricingRuleId or replacing it with newId in handleSycUpdate(); on error paths the library returns null and setPricingruleresponse(null) is called before severity assignment.
